name: get_capabilities
description: List verified data and known unavailable metrics; does not wake the watch.

name: get_heart_rate
description: Read the existing real-time HR cache; never starts a second HR listener. Source sampling age is unverified.

name: get_device_status
description: Query watch battery, charging and connection state through the explicitly enabled Wi-Fi bridge.

fresh.description: Bypass the saved status cache when true.

name: measure_pressure
description: Measure atmospheric pressure in hPa for 1 to 10 seconds. Requires watch bridge standby; holds CPU only for the bounded request.

fresh.description: Request a new measurement instead of an allowed recent result.

name: measure_motion
description: Measure raw watch-axis accelerometer including gravity (m/s^2), or gyroscope (rad/s), for 1 to 10 seconds. Does not infer steps or activity.

name: cancel_measurement
description: Cancel the active bounded sensor measurement. Does not stop standby or heart-rate broadcast. Omitting request_id captures the current measurement once.
